heading: Features
sub_headings: Connect with customers for their inquiries
paragraphs: You can generate a link for specific criteria and then share it in your advertising medium. The people those who are interested in the ads can get a form to fill up while clicking the link. Thus, the process of connecting with customers becomes easy.
When the customer fills and submits the form, the inquiry will be sent to the database of this software and can be viewed in the software.
We can customize for what all fields can be viewed by the inquirer for submitting the inquiry.
You can see all the inquiries that have been raised till the current date on your home screen.
You can enter common information in master screens, so that it can be reused in other screens.
You can personalize the look and feel of the applications
You can export the data displayed in some master screens as PDF, excel or CSV format.
